mapper.select:
SELECT SQL_ID, PLAN_HASH_VALUE, SQL_TEXT, PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME, MODULE, ACTION, ELAPSED_TIME / 1000000 AS ELAPSED_TIME_MS, CPU_TIME / 1000000 AS CPU_TIME_MS, USER_IO_WAIT_TIME / 1000000 AS IO_WAIT_TIME_MS, EXECUTIONS, PX_SERVERS_EXECUTIONS, ELAPSED_TIME / EXECUTIONS / 1000000 AS AVG_ELAPSED_TIME, BUFFER_GETS, DISK_READS, DIRECT_WRITES, FIRST_LOAD_TIME, LAST_ACTIVE_TIME FROM V$SQL WHERE ELAPSED_TIME > 1000000 -- 超过1秒的查询 AND PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP') AND UPPER(SQL_TEXT) NOT LIKE '%DBMS_%' AND UPPER(SQL_TEXT) NOT LIKE '%V$%VIEW%'
AND FIRST_LOAD_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{param.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND LAST_ACTIVE_TIME <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{param.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ELAPSED_TIME / 1000000 >= #{param.minExecuteTime}
ORDER BY ELAPSED_TIME DESC

SELECT a.TABLESPACE_NAME, ROUND(a.BYTES / 1024 / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS TOTAL_SPACE_GB, ROUND((a.BYTES - b.BYTES) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS USED_SPACE_GB, ROUND(b.BYTES / 1024 / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS FREE_SPACE_GB, ROUND((a.BYTES - b.BYTES) * 100 / a.BYTES, 2) AS USAGE_PERCENT FROM (SELECT TABLESPACE_NAME, SUM(BYTES) BYTES FROM DBA_DATA_FILES GROUP BY TABLESPACE_NAME) a, (SELECT TABLESPACE_NAME, SUM(BYTES) BYTES, MAX(BYTES) LARGEST FROM DBA_FREE_SPACE GROUP BY TABLESPACE_NAME) b WHERE a.TABLESPACE_NAME = b.TABLESPACE_NAME ORDER BY USAGE_PERCENT DESC

SELECT i.INDEX_NAME, i.TABLE_NAME, i.INDEX_TYPE, i.UNIQUENESS, i.STATUS, i.NUM_ROWS, i.LEAF_BLOCKS, i.DISTINCT_KEYS, s.EXECUTIONS, s.BUFFER_GETS, s.DISK_READS FROM DBA_INDEXES i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OBJECT_NAME, SUM(EXECUTIONS) EXECUTIONS, SUM(BUFFER_GETS) BUFFER_GETS, SUM(DISK_READS) DISK_READS FROM V$SQL WHERE UPPER(SQL_TEXT) LIKE '%{tableName}%' GROUP BY OBJECT_NAME ) s ON i.INDEX_NAME = s.OBJECT_NAME WHERE i.TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{param.tableName}) ORDER BY s.EXECUTIONS DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT i.INDEX_NAME, i.TABLE_NAME, i.INDEX_TYPE, i.UNIQUENESS, i.STATUS, u.USED FROM DBA_INDEXES i LEFT JOIN DBA_OBJECT_USAGE u ON i.INDEX_NAME = u.OBJECT_NAME WHERE i.TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{param.tableName}) AND i.UNIQUENESS = 'NONUNIQUE' AND (u.USED = 'NO' OR u.USED IS NULL) AND i.INDEX_NAME NOT LIKE 'SYS_%'

SELECT LEVEL, ID, PARENT_ID, OPERATION, OPTIONS, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, OPTIMIZER, COST, CARDINALITY, BYTES, OTHER_TAG, OTHER, DISTRIBUTION FROM ( SELECT LEVEL, ID, PARENT_ID, OPERATION, OPTIONS, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, OPTIMIZER, COST, CARDINALITY, BYTES, OTHER_TAG, OTHER, DISTRIBUTION FROM TABLE(DBMS_XPLAN.DISPLAY_CURSOR( (SELECT SQL_ID FROM V$SQL WHERE SQL_TEXT = #{param.sqlText} AND ROWNUM = 1) )) ) START WITH ID = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR ID = PARENT_ID ORDER BY ID

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V$SESSION WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS ACTIVE_SESSIONS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V$SESSION) AS TOTAL_SESSIONS, (SELECT VALUE FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME = 'parse count (total)') AS PARSE_COUNT, (SELECT VALUE FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME = 'parse count (hard)') AS HARD_PARSE_COUNT, (SELECT VALUE FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME = 'execute count') AS EXECUTE_COUNT, (SELECT VALUE FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME = 'user commits') AS USER_COMMITS, (SELECT VALUE FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME = 'user rollbacks') AS USER_ROLLBACKS, (SELECT VALUE FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME = 'logical read bytes') / 1024 / 1024 AS LOGICAL_READ_MB, (SELECT VALUE FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME = 'physical read bytes') / 1024 / 1024 AS PHYSICAL_READ_MB, (SELECT VALUE FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME = 'physical write bytes') / 1024 / 1024 AS PHYSICAL_WRITE_MB FROM DUAL

SELECT SQL_ID, SUBSTR(SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) AS SQL_TEXT_PREVIEW, ELAPSED_TIME / 1000000 AS ELAPSED_TIME_SEC, EXECUTIONS, (ELAPSED_TIME / EXECUTIONS) / 1000000 AS AVG_ELAPSED_TIME_SEC, MODULE, PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME FROM V$SQL WHERE EXECUTIONS > 0 AND PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY ELAPSED_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT (SELECT ROUND(SUM(USED_SPACE) / SUM(TOTAL_SPACE) * 100, 2) FROM ( SELECT TABLESPACE_NAME, SUM(BYTES) TOTAL_SPACE FROM DBA_DATA_FILES GROUP BY TABLESPACE_NAME ) a, ( SELECT TABLESPACE_NAME, SUM(BYTES) USED_SPACE FROM DBA_SEGMENTS GROUP BY TABLESPACE_NAME ) b WHERE a.TABLESPACE_NAME = b.TABLESPACE_NAME ) AS TABLESPACE_USAGE_PERCENT, (SELECT ROUND(VALUE / 1024 / 1024 / 1024, 2) FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME = 'sga_target') AS SGA_SIZE_GB, (SELECT ROUND(VALUE / 1024 / 1024 / 1024, 2) FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME = 'pga_aggregate_target') AS PGA_SIZE_GB FROM DUAL

SELECT e.EVENT, e.TOTAL_WAITS, e.TIME_WAITED / 100 AS TIME_WAITED_SEC, ROUND(e.AVERAGE_WAIT / 100, 2) AS AVG_WAIT_SEC FROM V$SYSTEM_EVENT e WHERE e.WAIT_CLASS != 'Idle' AND e.TOTAL_WAITS > 0 ORDER BY e.TIME_WAITED DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT EVENT, TOTAL_WAITS, TIME_WAITED, AVERAGE_WAIT, WAIT_CLASS FROM V$SYSTEM_EVENT WHERE WAIT_CLASS != 'Idle' AND TOTAL_WAITS > 0 ORDER BY TIME_WAITED DESC

SELECT t.TABLE_NAME, t.NUM_ROWS, t.BLOCKS, t.EMPTY_BLOCKS, t.AVG_SPACE, t.CHAIN_CNT, ROUND((t.EMPTY_BLOCKS / t.BLOCKS) * 100, 2) AS FRAGMENTATION_PERCENT, s.BYTES / 1024 / 1024 AS SIZE_MB FROM DBA_TABLES t JOIN DBA_SEGMENTS s ON t.TABLE_NAME = s.SEGMENT_NAME WHERE t.OWNER = UPPER(#{param.schema}) AND t.NUM_ROWS > 0 AND t.BLOCKS > 0 ORDER BY FRAGMENTATION_PERCENT DESC
SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, DATA_LENGTH, NULLABLE, NUM_NULLS, NUM_DISTINCT, DENSITY, HISTOGRAM FROM DBA_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{tableName}) ORDER BY COLUMN_ID

WITH QUERY_COLUMNS AS ( SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(SQL_TEXT), 'WHERE\s+.*?\b(\w+)\s*=', 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS COLUMN_NAME, COUNT(*) AS FREQUENCY FROM V$SQL WHERE UPPER(SQL_TEXT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{tableName}) || '%' AND SQL_TEXT NOT LIKE '%DBMS_%' GROUP BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(SQL_TEXT), 'WHERE\s+.*?\b(\w+)\s*=', 1, 1, NULL, 1) HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ) SELECT COLUMN_NAME, FREQUENCY FROM QUERY_COLUMNS WHERE COLUMN_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY FREQUENCY DESC
SELECT INDEX_NAME, INDEX_TYPE, UNIQUENESS, STATUS, NUM_ROWS, LEAF_BLOCKS, DISTINCT_KEYS, CLUSTERING_FACTOR FROM DBA_INDEXES WHERE TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{tableName}) ORDER BY INDEX_NAME

SELECT s.SID, s.SERIAL#, s.USERNAME, s.OSUSER, s.MACHINE, s.PROGRAM, s.SQL_ID, s.STATUS, s.LAST_CALL_ET, sq.SQL_TEXT, sq.MODULE, sq.ACTION FROM V$SESSION s JOIN V$SQL sq ON s.SQL_ID = sq.SQL_ID WHERE s.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND s.LAST_CALL_ET > #{param.threshold} AND s.USERNAME IS NOT NULL AND s.USERNAME NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY s.LAST_CALL_ET DESC
SELECT TABLE_NAME, NUM_ROWS, BLOCKS, EMPTY_BLOCKS, AVG_SPACE, CHAIN_CNT, AVG_ROW_LEN, LAST_ANALYZED FROM DBA_TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{tableName})

WITH POTENTIAL_INDEXES AS ( SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(SQL_TEXT), 'WHERE\s+.*?\b(\w+)\s*=', 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS COLUMN_NAME, COUNT(*) AS QUERY_COUNT, SUM(ELAPSED_TIME) / 1000000 AS TOTAL_ELAPSED_SEC FROM V$SQL WHERE PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME = UPPER(#{param.schema}) AND SQL_TEXT NOT LIKE '%DBMS_%' AND REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(SQL_TEXT), 'WHERE\s+.*?\b\w+\s*=') GROUP BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(SQL_TEXT), 'WHERE\s+.*?\b(\w+)\s*=', 1, 1, NULL, 1) HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ) SELECT p.COLUMN_NAME, p.QUERY_COUNT, p.TOTAL_ELAPSED_SEC, ROUND(p.TOTAL_ELAPSED_SEC * p.QUERY_COUNT) AS ESTIMATED_BENEFIT, 'CREATE INDEX IDX_' || UPPER(#{param.schema}) || '_' || p.COLUMN_NAME || ' ON ' || UPPER(#{param.schema}) || '.' || (SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM DBA_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE COLUMN_NAME = p.COLUMN_NAME AND ROWNUM = 1) || '(' || p.COLUMN_NAME || ')' AS CREATE_INDEX_SQL FROM POTENTIAL_INDEXES p LEFT JOIN DBA_INDEXES i ON i.TABLE_NAME = ( SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM DBA_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE COLUMN_NAME = p.COLUMN_NAME AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AND i.TABLE_NAME = ( SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM DBA_IND_COLUMNS WHERE COLUMN_NAME = p.COLUMN_NAME AND ROWNUM = 1 ) WHERE i.INDEX_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY ESTIMATED_BENEFIT DESC

SELECT SNAP_ID, BEGIN_INTERVAL_TIME, END_INTERVAL_TIME, PLAN_HASH_VALUE, EXECUTIONS_DELTA, PARSE_CALLS_DELTA, DISK_READS_DELTA, BUFFER_GETS_DELTA, ROWS_PROCESSED_DELTA, ELAPSED_TIME_DELTA / 1000000 AS ELAPSED_TIME_SEC, CPU_TIME_DELTA / 1000000 AS CPU_TIME_SEC, IOWAIT_DELTA / 1000000 AS IOWAIT_SEC FROM DBA_HIST_SQLSTAT s JOIN DBA_HIST_SNAPSHOT sn ON s.SNAP_ID = sn.SNAP_ID WHERE s.SQL_ID = #{param.sqlId} AND sn.BEGIN_INTERVAL_TIME >= SYSDATE - #{param.days} ORDER BY SNAP_ID DESC

SELECT s.SID, s.SERIAL#, s.USERNAME, s.OSUSER, s.MACHINE, s.PROGRAM, s.STATUS, s.LAST_CALL_ET, s.SQL_ID, sq.MODULE, sq.ACTION, w.EVENT, w.WAIT_CLASS, w.SECONDS_IN_WAIT FROM V$SESSION s LEFT JOIN V$SQL sq ON s.SQL_ID = sq.SQL_ID LEFT JOIN V$SESSION_WAIT w ON s.SID = w.SID WHERE s.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND s.USERNAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.LAST_CALL_ET DESC

SELECT ROUND((1 - (phy.value / (cur.value + con.value))) * 100, 2) AS BUFFER_CACHE_HIT_RATIO, ROUND((sum(gets) - sum(getmisses)) / sum(gets) * 100, 2) AS LIBRARY_CACHE_HIT_RATIO, ROUND(sum(pins) / (sum(pins) + sum(reloads)) * 100, 2) AS ROW_CACHE_HIT_RATIO FROM V$SYSSTAT cur, V$SYSSTAT con, V$SYSSTAT phy, V$LIBRARYCACHE WHERE cur.name = 'db block gets' AND con.name = 'consistent gets' AND phy.name = 'physical reads'
